title.en: Chapter 2 — A Photograph in Someone Else’s Hands

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال الملك: من خمس سنين، كنت بوارسو، وتعرفت على مغنية.
sentences.en: The king said: five years ago, I was in Warsaw, and met a singer.
Her name is Irene Adler.
Surely you have heard of her.

sentences.ar: هولمز قال، بلا ما يفتح عينه: واطسون، دور بالفهرس.
sentences.en: Holmes said, without opening his eyes: Watson, look in the index.

sentences.ar: كان عنده فهرس بكل الناس اللي بيهمه أمرهم.
sentences.en: He had an index of everyone who interested him.
And I found her between a rabbi and a naval officer.
I read: Irene Adler.
Born in New Jersey, 1858.
Opera singer.
Retired.
Living in London.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: وجلالتك تورطت مع هالسيدة، وكتبت لها رسايل.
sentences.en: Holmes said: and Your Majesty became entangled with this lady, and wrote her letters.
And now you want the letters back.
The king said: exactly.
But not just the letters.
Holmes said: a secret marriage?
The king said: no.
He said: legal papers?
He said: no.
He said: then the letters.
You can say they are forged.
The hand imitated.
The seal stolen.
The king said: there is a photograph.
Holmes said: a pity.
That was a serious mistake.
The king said: I was mad.
I was young.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: والصورة، إنت وهي سوا؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: and the photograph, you and she together?
The king said: together.
The king said: and now I am to marry.
The daughter of the king of Sweden.
And her family is very strict.

sentences.ar: أي ظل على اسمي، والزواج بيروح.
sentences.en: Any shadow on my name, and the marriage is gone.

sentences.ar: وإيرين بتقول إنها رح تبعت الصورة لهم، يوم إعلان الخطوبة.
sentences.en: And Irene says she will send the photograph to them, on the day the engagement is announced.
That means Monday.
Holmes said: have you tried to take it?
The king said: five times.
Her house searched twice.
Her bag stolen.
She was waylaid on the road.
And nothing.
Holmes said: so the woman is clever.

sentences.ar: قال الملك: أذكى من أي رجل قابلته.
sentences.en: The king said: cleverer than any man I have met.
And more beautiful.
And she wants to destroy me.
Because I promised her, and did not keep it.
Holmes said: and her address?

sentences.ar: قال الملك: بريوني لودج، سيربنتاين أفينيو، سانت جونز وود.
sentences.en: The king said: Briony Lodge, Serpentine Avenue, St. John's Wood.
Holmes said: and you give me a free hand?
And the money?

sentences.ar: الملك حط عالطاولة كيس، وقال: ألف جنيه، وبعدها ما بدي أعد.
sentences.en: The king put a bag on the table, and said: a thousand pounds, and after that I do not count.
And he left, the mask in his hand.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: بكرا الساعة تلاتة، يا واطسون.
sentences.en: Holmes said: tomorrow at three, Watson.

sentences.ar: تعال، بدي أحكي معك عن هالشغلة الزغيرة.
sentences.en: Come, I want to talk with you about this little matter.

sentences.ar: وأنا رحت عالبيت، وأنا مش عارف ليش هولمز مبسوط هيك.
sentences.en: And I went home, not knowing why Holmes was so pleased.

sentences.ar: وبعدين فهمت: لأنه أخيراً في خصم بيسوى.
sentences.en: And then I understood: because at last there was an opponent worth having.
